'''Michael Kessling DecipherCon 2000 Kessling's Report P1 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech on 10 October 2000 about [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="tr-d1319">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-deciphercon-2000-kesslings-report-p1d1319/ deciphercon-2000-kesslings-report-p1], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 10 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-deciphercon-2000-kesslings-report-p1d1319/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Michael Kessling's DecipherCon 2000 report, part 1, was posted off-site at www.angelfire.com/ga3/TREPORT; the Decktech post is only a pointer to it.
